exact: VEGF-activated platelet-derived growth factor receptor-beta signalling pathway
vascular endothelial growth factor-activated platelet-derived growth factor receptor-beta signaling pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) binding to a beta-type platelet-derived growth factor receptor (PDGFR) on the surface of a cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.
label: VEGF-activated platelet-derived growth factor receptor-beta signaling pathway
